content:
A group holidaying in Gozo reportedly fled their accommodation in the middle of the night after claiming they were terrorised by what they believed was a ghost, with one man alleging that a figure physically attacked him.

The bizarre incident allegedly unfolded in Xewkija during the night between 22nd and 23rd September, when a group of Maltese people, including a minor, were staying at a residence in the village.

According to accounts reported by Talk.mt, the group claimed the episode began when one woman heard someone calling “Ma… Ma…” and initially believed it was the child. They subsequently claimed to have seen a human-like shadow beneath a door and heard a voice, while their dog became distressed.

Things allegedly escalated as the group attempted to leave. One man claimed a figure approached him from behind, grabbed him and repeatedly threw him against a bed. He reportedly described the figure as having a white face with no eyes and claimed it later appeared to pass through a closed glass door.

The group also alleged that an oven door began violently opening and closing, a fan moved around the room as its cable was pulled, and buttons on a microwave appeared to activate on their own. No injuries were reported.

Lovin Malta contacted police over the unusual claims and can confirm that a 112 call was made, officers were dispatched to the residence and an official police report was subsequently filed. This confirms the police response and report, but not the alleged paranormal activity itself.

The group reportedly left the property after officers attended the scene, while a priest was said to have visited the residence several hours later.

Ghost, prank or something else entirely, what do you think happened?
